name: rscan-smart-scanner
description: CamScanner-style smart document scanner — Flask + OpenCV server pipeline and fully on-device PDF scanning in the browser.

scripts.parity: node tests/parity/parity_worker.js && node tests/parity/parity_geometry.js && node tests/parity/parity_full.js && node tests/parity/parity_receipt.js
scripts.test:python: sh -c 'PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$PY" -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p "test_*.py"'
scripts.test: bun run check && bun run parity && bun run test:js && bun run test:python
scripts.fixtures: sh -c 'PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && "$PY" scripts/gen_fixtures.py && "$PY" scripts/dump_stages.py && "$PY" scripts/dump_rgb.py'
